title: KDE Plasma 6 desktop
lede: A free-software desktop whose launcher and panel are blurred, translucent glass over a pink and blue wallpaper.
summary: Blurred translucent launcher and panel over a colorful wallpaper. KDE Plasma 6.4, 2025.
made: Plasma 6 released February 2024; screenshot of Plasma 6.4.5, 2025-10-20

evidence.note: Inspected the GPL-licensed screenshot [File:KDE Plasma 6.4.5 Light.png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:KDE_Plasma_6.4.5_Light.png) (1920 × 1080, Breeze Light theme, dated 2025-10-20) and stored a 1600 px copy.

styles.note: Partial fit. Only the launcher and the panel are glass; the application windows are opaque and grey.

context: The Commons record describes the file as a screenshot of KDE Plasma 6.4.5 in the Breeze Light theme. It credits the software to KDE Plasma, the wallpaper to Krystian Zajdel, and the screenshot to User:Michio.kawaii, and gives the license as GPL. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:KDE_Plasma_6.4.5_Light.png).
The same desktop line appears earlier in the catalogue as [KDE Plasma 4](ref:kde-plasma-4-desktop), whose glossy widgets belong to [Frutiger Aero](style:frutiger-aero).
observed: The wallpaper is a soft, out-of-focus scene of blue ribbon-like coils on a pink-to-red ground.
The application launcher at the lower left is a large panel with rounded top corners. The pink wallpaper shows through it as a smooth, blurred pastel wash.
The taskbar along the bottom is a translucent, pale strip; the wallpaper tint shows through it faintly.
The System Settings and Dolphin windows are opaque light grey with thin borders and a small radius.
Icons are flat and blue; the type is a neutral sans-serif.
interpretation: Plasma uses glass the way Fluent Acrylic recommends: on transient and shell surfaces, not on document windows. Measured chromatic share of the stored image is 0.37, most of it from the wallpaper.
borrow: Keep glass for the shell (launcher, panel) and leave working windows opaque.

images.alt: KDE Plasma desktop with a blurred translucent application launcher at lower left over a pink and blue wallpaper, and two opaque grey windows.
images.caption: KDE Plasma 6.4.5, Breeze Light, screenshot dated 2025-10-20. Software by KDE, wallpaper by Krystian Zajdel. GPL. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:KDE_Plasma_6.4.5_Light.png).
